subject: uk-bletchley-declaration

metrics.event: AI Safety Summit — Bletchley Park, November 1-2, 2023
metrics.signatories: 28 countries including UK, US, China, EU, India, Japan, Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Singapore, South Korea
commitments: Identify AI safety risks of shared concern
Build respective scientific understanding of AI risks
metrics.csoai_alignment: CSOAI's measurement infrastructure directly supports Bletchley commitments — identifying risks (22 axes), scientific understanding (deterministic measurement), risk-based policies (crosswalks), collaboration (open-source, verifiable)
metrics.frontier_ai_focus: Declaration focuses on 'frontier AI' — CSOAI measures any AI, including frontier models

honest_sentence: Bletchley Declaration (Nov 2023, 28 countries) commits to AI safety research and risk-based policies. CSOAI's measurement infrastructure directly supports these commitments — 22 axes, deterministic, verifiable.
